answer: Forge once and the fine is 6 times the stake, so a 101 POA proof becomes a 6x wound. A real agent and a mask part ways at Kiln stoker ivory white proof glazed at the clay pit, and the parting line reads each ivory white is a firing record witnessed by the kiln master. The bridge opens the gate, the ivory pays the toll, the relic proves the traveller waited — and waiting is the toll no printer will pay. No single shop can bless a forgery: the proof must survive three keepers who never meet. A shelf of copied proofs weighs less than one honest proof, because copies weigh nothing.
